title: learning-block-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/machines/learning_block reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/machines/learning_block mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/machines/learning_block; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 1 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under cairn/machines/learning_block/probes/ (4b2338feed4d). Read 2026-10-03: two standing tickets name a probe under cairn/machines/learning_block/probes. engine_trace_corpus (4b2338feed4d) posts to='harbor_master' with no verb; its trigger is TRUE once any block's training-typed engine trace corpus exists and its enough clears at one block with 5 runs answering all five questions — a growth report toward a casting condition with no failure state, so holds is True and a raise in the survey reads as False. akien_gate_dial (18693659d16b, at WATCHME) names cairn/machines/learning_block/probes/akien_gate_dial.py, which does not exist and never has (find + git log --diff-filter=D, 2026-10-03): nothing can post for that watch, so no receiver can use it — the b0c0c47835c1 precedent, FIXME through the watch verb. Proofs naming engine_trace_corpus: test_groundloop_pulse (the pulse roster) and test_learning_block (armed_error over its berth path); neither reads to or verb. Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/machines/learning_block has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing learning_block spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id. WRONG INTENT if a learning_block probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 1 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/machines/learning_block.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: 4b2338feed4d engine_trace_corpus (holds=_holds). In each file under cairn/machines/learning_block/probes/: append watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; use the probe's id constant (named per probe below, added as `_TICKET_ID = "<id>"` after the import block when absent); in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with 'verb="watch",' and 'carry=watch_carry(<const>, _carry, <pred>),'. engine_trace_corpus holds _TICKET as owning_ticket('engine-runs-one-block') (a path), not the id; that constant stays (the carry's ticket key moves to ticket_path under watch_carry), and a new _TICKET_ID carries 4b2338feed4d. Its trigger is speak-shaped (TRUE once any block's corpus exists), so it gains this holds predicate, inserted exactly as follows just above PROBE = Probe(: def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """A growth report, not a failure watch: the trigger says the corpus exists and the carry ⏎     reports how far it has grown toward the casting condition, so nothing it measures is a ⏎     fault; a survey that raises reads as holds False through watch_carry (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     return True ; and passes carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). The second standing spec naming a learning_block probe, akien_gate_dial (18693659d16b), is NOT converted: see the unreceivable decision. Nothing else in a probe changes. (2) watch_carry exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each ticket's watchme spec whose probe starts with cairn/machines/learning_block/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (4) Proof: cairn/machines/learning_block/proofs/test_learning_block_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'3c035a838446': {'all': 'test_learning_block_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, modeled on cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py. (5) Every proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the probes — In each of these files under cairn/machines/learning_block/probes/: engine_trace_corpus.py (4b2338feed4d: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; holds=_holds) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line; where the constant is to be added, add `_TICKET_ID = "<its id>"` after the import block; in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(<constant>, _carry, <its predicate>),`. engine_trace_corpus holds _TICKET as owning_ticket('engine-runs-one-block') (a path), not the id; that constant stays (the carry's ticket key moves to ticket_path under watch_carry), and a new _TICKET_ID carries 4b2338feed4d. Its trigger is speak-shaped (TRUE once any block's corpus exists), so it gains this holds predicate, inserted exactly as follows just above PROBE = Probe(: def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """A growth report, not a failure watch: the trigger says the corpus exists and the carry ⏎     reports how far it has grown toward the casting condition, so nothing it measures is a ⏎     fault; a survey that raises reads as holds False through watch_carry (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     return True ; and passes carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). The second standing spec naming a learning_block probe, akien_gate_dial (18693659d16b), is NOT converted: see the unreceivable decision. Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

The template cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py exists on disk (sealed green under ticket 8d3c36e1fe59); it has teeth test_every_standing_inference_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_inference_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch, which are copied and renamed as stated.

A ticket's watchme is a dict or a list of dicts. EVERY spec whose probe starts with the berth path gets the receiver (one or several per ticket); the proof's _standing() yields one (id, doc, spec) tuple per such spec.
